title: EGDI Keyword Thesaurus v3.0
description: The  EGDI Keyword Thesaurus v3.0, a revised and expanded version of the former GeoERA Keyword Thesaurus published in 2023 and was created as part of WP7 of the GSEU Project. It has changed the base URI from https://data.geoscience.earth/ncl/geoera/keyword/ to https://data.geoscience.earth/ncl/egdi/keyword/, including the concept scheme URI.The EU-funded GSEU project will establish the Geological Service for Europe. It will be based on best practices from previous initiatives. It will also provide a unified platform for accelerating the transition towards clean energy. The project will focus on the harmonisation and standardisation of the large amounts of data and information collected by existing geological surveys. This will make it easier to integrate and utilise. This project has received funding from the European Union's HORIZON.2.5 - Climate, Energy and Mobility programme under grant agreement No 101075609.
